picks.title: DeepSeek pause fundraise after comments on compute gap to US leaked (transcript)
picks.why_it_matters: DeepSeek's fundraising pause and leaked candid assessment of China's compute disadvantage signals potential openings for US-based AI infrastructure and model startups to capture enterprise deals that might have gone to Chinese alternatives.

picks.title: Inflect-Micro-v2: complete voice in 9.36M parameters
picks.why_it_matters: A production-quality voice model at under 10M parameters demonstrates the rapid commoditization of edge AI, creating investment opportunities in voice-enabled embedded applications and on-device AI startups.

picks.title: GM Backs Sodium Ion Batteries for U.S. Grid Storage
picks.why_it_matters: GM's validation of sodium-ion for grid storage signals a major OEM demand signal for startups in alternative battery chemistries and domestic energy storage supply chains.
